newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Tamil rebels kill 14 soldiers in eastern Sri Lanka.
newsitem.headline: Tamil rebels kill 14 soldiers in eastern Sri Lanka.

text.p: Tamil Tiger rebels killed 14 Sri Lankan soldiers when they ambushed an army patrol in eastern Trincomalee district on Sunday, military officials said.

They said an army road clearing patrol was attacked early on Sunday by the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) rebels. Reinforcements had been rushed to the spot and fighting was still going on, they added.
"We have sent reinforcements and the fighting is still on," a military official said in Trincomalee, 240 km (150 miles) east of the capital Colombo.
The official said the patrol was attacked at Pumoddai, 17.6 km (11 miles) north of Trincomalee.
The LTTE, who are fighting for an independent homeland for minority Tamils in Sri Lanka's north and east, killed 23 soldiers in another ambush in the eastern Batticaloa district last week.
The government says more than 50,000 people have been killed in the war, now in its 14th year. The LTTE say the number is higher.
